a.name: group_location_stamp
a.place: Lab Six, Zelgrad Sealed District Laboratory

steps.name: Worried Researcher
steps.text: You've been looking at these files for an entire day, director. You should get some rest, at least eat something...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Is this all of the Kushkina file, Gira?

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: I think... like you, though, I was recently reassigned, so I can't be sure there are no omissions.

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: I wasn't even given a logbook during the handover.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: All research data should be filed in the logbook, whether the data is valid or not. This is a problem.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Look at this. The progress reports jump straight from 03 to 21, the missing files listed as 'data lost'. Not even the raw records remain.

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: And these audio logs have clearly been tampered with. I took some time to listen to them, but there was nothing but useless noise.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: This is not normal. When I went to the security station to obtain security footage of Lab Six from prior to the handover, I found that all footage from the last three days have been deleted.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: All that they gave me were some maintenance logs. They said it provided a record of people come to and from Lab Six during these few days.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Guess what I found.

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: Beats me.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: On the day of the Kushkina test, there was a power outage that lasted about thirty minutes. The repair team arrived eight minutes after the outage began, but they were not able to fully mitigate the overload problem.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Following up on the trail, I found that the cooling pool had dried up that day, and all backup systems were destroyed, while the temperature of that thing underground remains at high levels—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: It's not going to blow up immediately, but things didn't go back to normal either.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: This means there's something else that's cooling it, but we don't know what it is!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Even so, the conclusion in the report was that risk levels were under control.

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: But the test succeed. The power of Kushkina was witnessed across half of Ursus...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Is that really something worth celebrating?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: My research was on how to turn the 'Prototype' into a reliable energy source, not an uncontrollable weapon.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: But all we know about Kushkina is that it's powerful, and it cannot be recreated in a controlled environment.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I don't even want to think about where these experiments are going.

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: Director... couldn't we just focus on doing experiments? If you question the Marshal's decisions—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I'm in no position to defy my orders...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: But I need to find out what's going on in this place.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: HR records... six from the data team, two from the risk assessment team, seven from the assembly team.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Reassignment... promotion... none of them are in Zelgrad anymore.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I can't reach any of them...

steps.name: Curious Researcher
steps.text: What are you looking for at an hour like this?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Something like notes from the previous supervisor. We ran into a roadblock during the day—

steps.name: Curious Researcher
steps.text: Well, if it's not here, it's probably not anywhere. The whole Lab Six staff was replaced. Surely you know what that means in this industry.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: What are you saying?

steps.name: Curious Researcher
steps.text: They must have screwed up somewhere, which means the previous supervisor would be held responsible, which means she wouldn't have left any notes behind.

steps.name: Curious Researcher
steps.text: We have to empty our pockets when we leave the building. If she really left, she wouldn't have been able to take anything associated with the project.

steps.name: Curious Researcher
steps.text: If you can't find it here, you won't find it anywhere.

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: Director?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Gira? What is it?

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: I thought about what you said and decided you should have this. It contains some unlogged notes that I found in a cabinet.

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: I didn't open them, but—I hope they can help you and the project.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Thank you, Gira...

steps.name: Gira
steps.text: Don't mention it, really!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Diary... blank scrap paper...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: The signature of the previous supervisor? Did all this belong to her?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: A notebook—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: What is this?
Words of despair are scrawled over the last page.

a.text: With what sanity I have left, I believe we will never find out the truth about this machine, not in the lifetime of Ursus.

spans.text: With what sanity I have left, I believe we will never find out the truth about this machine, not in the lifetime of Ursus.

a.text: It is so complex and contains such massive energy reserves that I can only consider it a work of God, and it is not our place to use it, either as a weapon or Originium generator.

spans.text: It is so complex and contains such massive energy reserves that I can only consider it a work of God, and it is not our place to use it, either as a weapon or Originium generator.

a.text: It is a complete black box with no credible theoretical basis on which to study it. Even more terrifying is that it seems to have a mind of its own, resisting our exploration of it.

spans.text: It is a complete black box with no credible theoretical basis on which to study it. Even more terrifying is that it seems to have a mind of its own, resisting our exploration of it.

a.text: This time, the explosion occurred in the wilderness. Next time, it could happen at Zelgrad, even Grypherburg.

spans.text: This time, the explosion occurred in the wilderness. Next time, it could happen at Zelgrad, even Grypherburg.

a.text: No one knows where this instrument came from or what it is, but one thing is clear: It is not a blessing to the empire, but a curse.

spans.text: No one knows where this instrument came from or what it is, but one thing is clear: It is not a blessing to the empire, but a curse.

steps.text: There are numerous graphs and diagrams in the notebook.
Some are smooth and clean, neat and tidy, while other peak and bottom out sharply or terminate suddenly. There appears to be little rhyme or reason to the data.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: 'Experiment outcome is not reproducible in whole or part. The overall state of Project Zero is...'

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Gosudar-batyushka...

spans.text: Gosudar-batyushka

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: There is no weapon. The successful test was just dumb luck.

spans.text: There
is
no weapon. The successful test was just dumb luck.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: (Hushed) All the 'energy'... they've gone into a bottomless pit.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Director Alita Valueva! The Army—the Generalik just had everyone in Lab Four arrested!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Why? What does he want?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: No idea. But they haven't been taken away yet. You should hurry!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I—why should I hurry?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Isn't your husband working in Lab Four?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I'm the director of Lab Six.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Doesn't matter. You can't pass.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I am Alita Valueva, director of Lab Six. I am demanding that Lab Four and its personnel be reassigned to the critical project at Lab Six.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Communicate this to your superior immediately.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Don't make me repeat myself again.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I don't want to repeat myself either—

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Do as she says.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Chief?

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: A chief of staff who has to take orders from a child who hasn't seen a single battle? Who would believe it?

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Open your eyes, soldier.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: General Anatoliy Svetlanov Buterin, in his infinite wisdom, has instructed that all requests by Lab Six are top-priority, whether it's the old one or the new one.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Where's the watch your mother gave you?

steps.name: Haggard Man
steps.text: Lost it.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Are you still taking your meds?

steps.name: Haggard Man
steps.text: Not for a long time. I would be kicked out of the lab if they found out.

steps.name: Haggard Man
steps.text: I'm not leaving you, Lita.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Then stop deceiving me, Klim.

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: I've never...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Your recklessness almost killed everyone in your lab.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Besides, I never told you about my comms channel. How did you find out?

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: You were still using the system we built together when we were in school. Only I know about it here...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Why didn't you ask me?

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: You don't—

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: You don't want to see me, do you?

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: Oh, I'm not trying to blame you—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I know you wanted to see me, but I didn't want to see you. I don't care about anyone who comes and goes in this place, and you need to know that you're the same to me right now.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: The only thing that matters to me right now is completing Kushkina.

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: Lita—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Don't call me that. You should not have joined a project you were unsuited to, just because of me. You should have gone to Lada and stayed with her.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Even a broken family is home.

steps.name: Klim
steps.text: Home. Yes, Lita! In the last communication, I heard—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: No, don't say it. I don't want to know.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Stay away from the work here. Don't try to send any messages out with my channel.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Go get some cleaning work from Logistics. Stay away from all of this.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: All of B3 is assigned to Lab Five.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Their work may be more aligned with your company's. Their field of research is the progression of Oripathy infection.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Would you like to take a look?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, thank you... there's a question I've mean meaning to ask, Madam Alita Valueva—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do we really have to be accompanied by so many soldiers?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Ah, I forgot to explain.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Visitors must be accompanied by military representatives at all times. I informed them in accordance with regulations.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: To prevent espionage and leaks concerning secret projects. I'm sure you understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I understand.

options: Will they intrude on our conversations?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: There is no need to worry. The security measures only come in play when necessary. Otherwise, you can treat them as though they don't exist.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: If you insist, we can stop and develop trust in not having conversations interrupted.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's no need—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: For example, I'm curious about the analysis on the 'Prototype' that you provided. How did you know so much?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: 'Prototype'?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: (Whisper) Maybe she means the Sarcophagus. Let the Doctor handle it.

options: A Rhodes Island member was involved in its research.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: How much does this researcher know about the Prototype?

options: No one knows the Sarcophagus better than her.
She knows everything there is to know about the Sarcophagus.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Sarcophagus... that's a name I haven't heard in a long time. I've gotten used to calling it the Prototype.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Are you familiar with her research?

options: I have read all the files she left behind.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: ...'Left behind', you say. Where did she go?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She is temporarily absent from Rhodes Island. That's why she's not with us today.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I suppose you will do. The research has encountered some obstacles, and there are quite a few things in the files that I don't fully understand, for which I could use your help.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: The most pressing issue at present is that the Prototype is in a constant state of overheating and unable to be fully cooled. Certain experiments and operations are unable to be performed, causing the project to grind to a halt.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: No one knows how to stop the overheating and return the Prototype's output to normal boundaries.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Whisper) Sounds like the Sarcophagus has entered a protected state after overloading.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Did you say something?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Amiya—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's alright. You can tell her.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It sounds like the Sarcophagus has entered a protected state after overloading. How long has it been in this state?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Since I took over Lab Six five days ago, maybe even before that.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: That's not right...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: If you would like to know more details, we can go directly to Lab Six.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I won't be letting you go to any other project. You have to stay.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: We can talk on the way.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: ...That's how I was reassigned here.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I first heard about the Sarcophagus when I was a student. It seemed like an urban legend, and young people are always bold and curious—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I wrote a letter to the mayor, a youthful plea that expressed my hope to join research on the Sarcophagus when I grew up. I didn't receive a response, of course.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Who would have thought that I would be studying it here, twenty years later?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you from Chernobog?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Heh, yes. I was born in Chernobog, as was my daughter... I hope to be buried there when I die.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why do you say this—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: How old are you, child?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not really a child anymore...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I was sent here as, um, a researcher. I'm not so little anymore.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Your generation will always be children in the eyes of mine. Perhaps one day you'll understand, when you find yourself in our shoes.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I left that place because of my work. I've practically forgotten what my daughter looks like.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Has she grown? What is life like for her? Has she made new friends?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: All I know is that she's still alive, that she survived the disaster at Chernobog five years ago. Other than that, I know nothing about my proud little girl scout...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I know almost nothing about Lada anymore.
Isolated research project, Chernobog, girl scout, Lada.
Amiya remembers Crownslayer's conjecture in her report to the Grypherburg office.
She looks closely at the woman's golden hair, the shape of her face becoming increasingly familiar.
The conjecture grows more certain by the second, and Amiya could not help but ask.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could you please repeat your last name?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Valueva.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know a Lada Valueva. She's around my age, and she's from Chernobog too—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She was in the Ursus Youth Scouts. She joined Rhodes Island as an operator, and is currently continuing her education in Deity Grypherburg.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lada has been looking for her parents... I'm thinking you might be her mother?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: But if I am... that's the best news I've heard in ages.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe you can come with us to Grypherburg, once we settle things here.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Maybe I could. Grypherburg isn't too far from Zelgrad.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lada would be delighted to see you.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Yes. She wouldn't even yell at us.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: She is kind, gentle, a much better daughter than we deserve.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I... I really want to see her again.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Stop, Alita Valueva. You are approaching a top-secret area.
Until this cold, hard reminder, Amiya did not notice that they have journeyed into the depths of the laboratory.
Indeed, the narrow, curved corridor before them seems to lead to a place that few are allowed to step foot in.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: They have been sent by the council to assist. They are not ordinary visitors.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Protocol requires that I seek confirmation from my superiors.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: You should not proceed any further until permission has been granted.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I am the director of Lab Six, and this is necessary for our operation. You have no idea how much could have been achieved in the time wasted waiting here.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: We are simply following orders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What do we do—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Watch your feet. The corridor leading to the observation room is not connected to the central power supply, and emergency lighting could be fickle at the best of times...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: But I'll find it. Give me a moment.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: (Whisper) You'll have less than ten seconds. Do not hesitate.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: (Whisper) If you have any questions, you should ask them now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is the Sarcophagus still in a condition to supply energy to Ursus?

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Now is not the time to talk about the theoretical future...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Never mind... I trust in your resolve.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Found it.

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I put in your hands the fate of Lada, and of millions more.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is—

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: 'Emergency lighting.'

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Go, Amiya, and take your friends.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What about you?!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Go—

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: ...Valueva has mutinied.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Prepare to attack.
The emergency lighting comes back in a matter of moments. A closing blast door now separates the scientist and the Rhodes Island team.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Valueva—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alita!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: There is no time! Promise to stop the Sarcophagus! You must do it!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: It is being fueled by the lives of thousands of kidnapped, dismembered Infected!

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: Too late... it took too long for me to find out. All the research here was designed to reinforce the profit chain of the First Army...

steps.name: Alita
steps.text: I was an accomplice. I can never look Lada in the eye again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No! But you—you wanted to see her again!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The door's closing, Amiya! Get your hand clear!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why?

a.text: ...Perhaps I'm simply tired. Tired of deception, of the passions of love and hate. How could one who has lost the capacity to love go back to those whom she loved?
Fortunately, Lada is not like me. She has always been strong, always true to her word.
She'll miss me, I'm sure. There will be pain and sorrow for her in the future, but there will be even more joy and happiness.

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: There's no message that I need you to deliver. Let me just...

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: Let me believe it to the end.
A bloody palm mark is painted on the switch, like an immovable seal upon the thick door.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alita...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Stand up, Amiya.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: This door is thick and jams electrical signals. It's unlikely that those on the outside will be able to force it open in short order.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Alita Valueva has bought us valuable time.

options: We have no time to waste.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's begin.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: This is the core of the Sarcophagus... I've never seen it with my own eyes.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: But something feels off about it...
The megastructure feels both familiar and alien. You still remember its faint silhouette, but what lies before you know is different.
It is not a distant memory. Several years ago, Amiya awakened you from this legacy of a previous civilization, which you sealed away together with Kal'tsit.
More memories come rushing back, mixed with memories buried even deeper.

a.text: Why insist on leaving behind such an inefficient machine, {@nickname}?

spans.text: Why insist on leaving behind such an inefficient machine, {@nickname}?

a.text: We have more convenient ways of retaining our consciousness... is this part of your obsession with 'life'?

spans.text: We have more convenient ways of retaining our consciousness... is this part of your obsession with 'life'?

a.text: Coming back to the old argument, are we?

spans.text: Coming back to the old argument, are we?

a.text: But of course, I will not deny you such a small liberty... I will add another entry to AMa-10's mission.

spans.text: But of course, I will not deny you such a small liberty... I will add another entry to AMa-10's mission.

a.text: Not satisfied with just touching consciousness? Would you find more comfort to hold my hand like this?

spans.text: Not satisfied with just touching consciousness? Would you find more comfort to hold my hand like this?

a.text: {@nickname}... I know that you want this, here and now, to be a memory preserved forever.

spans.text: {@nickname}... I know that you want this, here and now, to be a memory preserved forever.

a.text: Not cast into oblivion, when the ultimate destruction comes.{@nickname}

spans.text: Not cast into oblivion, when the ultimate destruction comes.{@nickname}

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you alright, Doctor? What happened?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I saw fragments, snapshots... but nothing clear.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just felt your pain in that instant...

options: I guess... I do have a bit of a headache.
Can you assess the current status of the Sarcophagus, Mon3tr?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Based on my inspection just now...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The Sarcophagus...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: ...has been destroyed.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: Chief.

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: ...Put him through.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Major Razin, it seems that your progress has fallen behind initial expectations.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: You will not arrive at the satellite city in time, at this rate.

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: We don't have enough power, Your High Excellency. We're already diverting as much as we can from temperature controls. The men can hardly sleep with the cold...

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: Though I suppose none of that matters to you.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: You are correct.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: In fact, you're not doing enough.

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: There's no point in sending an exhausted force to try to steal the weapon for you. We would be easy targets for the First Army.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: It seems you have liberated yourself from your concern for Lieutenant Sirka's safety.

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: You could have earned Sechin's true loyalty, if you did not hold her life and those of the others hostage.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Anyone can make promises. I only believe what I see. I am not in the habit of trusting someone who has already betrayed me once. Besides, you don't deserve it.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: You people do not deserve kindness. I should have learned my lesson sooner.

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: We're behind by a day or two, and you act like we've already surrendered to the First Army.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Let me guess what you're planning to do.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: At the next communication, you'll tell me that you've dismissed most of the soldiers from the ship to conserve energy, in order to devote full resources to my mission—

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: I won't, not while Sirka's still at the base—

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Then, you will go rogue once the ship has left communications range.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Whether to seize the weapon and use it as leverage to negotiate with me, betray me again and go over to the First Army, or come back alone to attempt an assassination...

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: You'll have all the choices in front of you once the Volnov has left my control, and your comrades are safe, won't you?

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Did you think I wouldn't know about your foolish plan?

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: You poor, pathetic Volnik...

spans.text: You poor, pathetic
Volnik

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Has no one told you that this name, which you use to distinguish yourselves from the rest of Ursus, comes from a promise that has never been fulfilled?

a.name: group_location_stamp
a.time: Upper Deck, Flagship of the Fourth Army's main fleet

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Defender Regiments are in position, sir.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Has the vanguard departed the front lines?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: According to the reports, yes. There has been no alarm from the Second Army's outposts. All is quiet... is this normal?

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: That's not for you to think about.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Report the ships' positions to Marshal Kuznetsov, and tell him...

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: The Fourth Army is ready—

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: We will advance upon Zelgrad, satellite city of the First Army.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: ...That will do. One more thing. Reserve two hours before the citizen's forum starts. I would like to meet with Duchess Volkina in the palace.

steps.name: Respectful Servant
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: And tell Witte—

steps.name: Panicking Servant
steps.text: —Your Imperial Majesty!

steps.name: Respectful Servant
steps.text: You are not on duty today, Saveliy. Who permitted you to run amok in the Amber Palace like this?

steps.name: Respectful Servant
steps.text: I will take him away, sir. I assure you that this will not happen again.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: ...Hand him to the Third Bureau. I don't want to see him in here again.

steps.name: Panicking Servant
steps.text: Do with me as you will, sir, but pray listen to me!

steps.name: Panicking Servant
steps.text: The Fourth Army has left their positions and is proceeding towards Zelgrad!

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Respectful Servant
steps.text: Insolence! Who instructed you to spread such alarmist talk, when not even the Chairman has confirmed the news?

steps.name: Panicking Servant
steps.text: I didn't believe it at first either, but it's the truth!

steps.name: Panicking Servant
steps.text: I was simply helping to keep an eye on things... I never expected such a thing would happen!

steps.name: Panicking Servant
steps.text: They have crossed the Second Army's lines unscathed! I never thought this would happen!

steps.name: Respectful Servant
steps.text: They crossed the lines without engaging in combat? Do you mean—

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: The Second Army...

steps.name: Panicking Servant
steps.text: The Second Army has gone over to the traitors, sir!

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: ...Evgeny Andrianov.

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: You never meant for Sechin to take that weapon from Zelgrad, did you?

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: We're cannon fodder for you to determine the Second Army's cooperation. The other unit that you were talking about is your main force.

steps.name: Scioppa
steps.text: You've gambled everything on something that you hardly know anything about. You're out of your mind.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Pushing all of one's chips in is only madness when the outcome is yet uncertain. I forgive you for failing to understand.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: But I'm not negotiating with you. There's no need for me to beat around the bush, now that you've finally realized what's happening.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: This is the last time I tolerate your probing. Lieutenant Sirka will not be harmed before you fulfill your duties.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: Make yourselves useful while you still have value as a diversion, so that I might yet deign to recycle you.

steps.name: Evgeny
steps.text: But if you continue on your leisurely pace, you can expect to be left by the roadside when my flagship catches up to the Volnov and crushes you like an ant.

and crushes you like an ant.
